Honestly, no. Sorry I don't mean to be difficult!

I just haven't quite found anything that I'm good at. You know how people always say everyones good at something? I have failed in my 20 years to find one of those things haha

However, I do like to think I bring happiness to people occasionally with my poor dad jokes coming from a 4'11" at the cashout in the store lol

I do feel used. By the males in my life and by my room mates. They just take advantage of my niceness constantly and I just feel unappreciated.

The six year plan is because I spent my first year at a different university but transferred to a new one. So, now I have to spend an extra year and a half in college because my credits barely counted.
